notes.title: Development update #1
notes.content:
Lately i´ve been going to work implementing new features to the game and some new levels. These are all implemented and intended to be included in the full game upon release. 

Added Steam achievements - And with that comes new things to collect and find, other than bones

Cloud saves - I've been looking into adding cloud saves so your saves will remain safe

A new gameplay biome - Forests are great and all but i've been expanding upon the art of the biomes

Dynamic lighting - As part of the art direction certain levels will have a bit more varied and dynamic lighting

Have you been enjoying the demo? Feel free to add any feedback or thoughts in the comments, i'll read every single one of them. 

Regards, 
Mr Sausage
